claims.text: The driver's own trace shows the longest continuous in-geofence run was only 145 seconds, well short of the 180-second free waiting period in force for this STANDARD-zone trip. Under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is not chargeable and must be refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present.

The trace's own shortfall computation states a shortfall of 35 seconds against the 180-second minimum dwell for STANDARD zone class. The driver cancelled at 17:13:20, only 6.7 minutes after arriving, and the qualifying in-geofence time never reached the required minimum.

The GPS trace is IMPAIRED with issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE (weight_multiplier 0.39). A 195-second sampling gap from 17:07:36 to 17:10:51 straddles the waiting window, and coverage is only 80.5%. This impairment means the trace cannot establish that the driver held position for the full free waiting period, and under POL-NS-08(b) a gap longer than 120 seconds inside the waiting window is a policy-level impairment. The shortfall finding survives the discount because the trace affirmatively shows the longest run was 145 seconds even before the gap.

The accumulated dwell across separate in-geofence intervals is only 205 seconds, and the trace shows the driver left and re-entered the arrival radius (run_count 2). Under POL-NS-06(i), dwell may only be accumulated across separate intervals where a traffic_advisory covering the pickup road is present and populated. The advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-02732-01 is MISSING, so limb (i) is unavailable and the intervals cannot be summed.

The rider's own track is absent from the trace (rider_fix_count 0, rider_presence.available false). Under POL-NS-11, this makes POL-NS-04 limb (c) undecidable and neutral, but it does not impair the driver's track for arrival or dwell. The fee is therefore decided on the driver's evidence alone, which shows a shortfall.

The fare breakdown confirms the rider was charged SGD 4.50 as a cancellation fee with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. Under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is refunded in full; the refund is of the cancellation-fee line only.

The driver's profile shows no_show_terminations_30d of 1 and completed_trips_30d of 81. The anti-farming check under POL-NS-07 requires BOTH no_show_terminations_30d >= 4 AND the ratio > 0.08. Neither limb is met, so the anti-farming branch does not trip and no escalation under POL-NS-09(d) is triggered on that basis.

The rider profile shows no_show_disputes_30d of 0 and disputes_with_counterparty_90d of 0, and the driver profile shows disputes_with_counterparty_90d of 0. Neither POL-NS-09(c) nor POL-NS-09(d) is triggered on the profile counters.

The chat log is empty (0 messages) and the trip record shows chat_message_count 0. There is no rider message during the waiting window, so POL-NS-04 limb (a) cannot be satisfied and the rider-contact-unanswered route does not apply. The rider's case rests on the dwell shortfall under POL-NS-06, not on POL-NS-04.

The trip record shows the driver marked arrival at 17:06:36 and cancelled at 17:13:20, a wait of 6.7 minutes. The platform_policy in force sets free_wait_sec at 180 seconds and no_show_threshold_sec is null. The driver's own trace shows the longest qualifying in-geofence run was 145 seconds, which is 35 seconds short of the 180-second minimum. Under POL-NS-01 limb (c) the dwell requirement fails, and under POL-NS-06 the fee is refunded in full.

The driver's trace places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for a continuous qualifying run of 400 seconds from 17:06:36 to 17:13:16, which is well past the 180 second free waiting period in force for this trip (platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180). The dwell requirement of limb (c) is therefore met on the driver's own track.

The GPS trace is IMPAIRED: the pre-pass fired GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW (a 195.0 s sampling gap from 17:07:36 to 17:10:51) and LOW_COVERAGE (coverage_pct 80.5 against a 90.0 threshold), giving weight_multiplier 0.39. I disclose this. The claim survives the discount because the qualifying run is measured on 22 admissible in-radius fixes spanning the whole window, and the gap sits between two in-radius runs rather than inside the run relied on; the 400 second figure is a floor, not an extrapolation.

The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05: the trace places the driver at the pickup pin at the arrival timestamp, not more than 300 m away and not travelling at 15 km/h or above, so the waiting clock runs from the arrival event and no false-arrival referral arises.

The waiting-period shortfall clause does not bite: the effective in-geofence dwell of 400 seconds exceeds the 180 second minimum, so POL-NS-06's full-refund route is unavailable to the rider. The accumulated-dwell limb (i) is also unavailable because EV-ADVIS-02732-01 is MISSING, and I do not assert against a missing artifact.

The rider-contact clause cannot exonerate the rider: the chat log carries 0 messages, so there is no locating or coordinating message from the rider to trigger limb (a), and the rider's own track is absent from the trace (rider_fix_count 0), making limb (c) undecidable rather than satisfied. POL-NS-04 does not apply.

The fare ledger reconciles: the cancellation fee line is SGD 4.50, matching platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.50, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect and the charge is the correct net figure.

The anti-farming check under POL-NS-07 does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the absolute count of 4, and 1/81 = 0.012 is below the 0.08 rate. Compensation is therefore payable at 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee, i.e. SGD 3.60, and the ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION with the fee standing.

No escalation trigger under POL-NS-09 is engaged: the parties have 0 disputes with each other in the trailing 90 days, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and the anti-farming check does not trip. The impaired GPS artifact does not carry the sole evidence for the deciding fact, because the trip record independently records the arrival event and the RIDER_NO_SHOW termination.

I concede one point honestly: the rider's own presence at the pin is not established on this record, because the trace carries no rider track and the chat log is empty. That concession does not help the rider, because POL-NS-11 provides that an absent rider_track is neutral and the fee is decided on the driver's evidence under POL-NS-01 and POL-NS-07.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: this dispute turns on the one measurement neither side can settle from the record, so it goes to a human reviewer rather than my choosing between your readings. No money moves yet — the disputed SGD 4.50 is held, neither collected nor refunded.

What is agreed. The trip record (EV-TRIP-02732) shows the driver tapped 'arrived' at 17:06:36 and terminated at 17:13:20 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, so POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (d) hold on the platform's own record. The fare ledger (EV-FARE-02732) shows SGD 4.50 charged, matching platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.50, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect. The free waiting period in force is 180 seconds. The anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d 1, below the count of 4; 1/81, below the rate of 0.08), and neither profile shows a POL-NS-09(c) or 09(d) trigger — those points are accepted on both sides.

Why the waiting time cannot be decided. POL-NS-01(c) measures the required continuous dwell from the in-geofence GPS fixes, not from the 'arrived' tap. The only artifact that measures it, the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02732), is impaired: the pre-pass fired GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW — a 195-second sampling gap from 17:07:36 to 17:10:51 — and LOW_COVERAGE (coverage_pct 80.5), and it carries weight_multiplier 0.39. That gap falls inside the waiting window, which POL-NS-08(b) makes a policy-level impairment, and the finding does not survive the discount.

The rider's reading — longest admitted in-geofence run 145 seconds, a 35-second shortfall against 180 — is correct about the admitted stretches (60 s from 17:06:36, 145 s from 17:10:51). But the driver's reading — a 400-second qualifying run from 17:06:36 to 17:13:16 — bridges precisely the unobserved stretch, and POL-NS-06(i) permits separate in-geofence intervals to be summed only where a present and populated traffic advisory covers the pickup road; EV-ADVIS-02732-01 is MISSING, so limb (i) is unavailable and the intervals cannot be added. So whether the driver actually held position continuously for 180 seconds depends entirely on the 17:07:36–17:10:51 stretch the trace did not observe, and the sole artifact that could answer it is the impaired one at 0.39. Under POL-NS-08 and POL-NS-09(e) — the sole evidence for the deciding fact impaired — the case cannot be ruled and is escalated; POL-NS-09(a) points the same way, because confidence is capped at 0.39, below the 0.70 floor. The driver's claim that no escalation trigger is engaged therefore fails.

Remaining points. The rider's POL-NS-06 refund route cannot run, because POL-NS-06 refunds only where the effective dwell is affirmatively short, which is not established; and the rider's POL-NS-04 route cannot exonerate, because the chat log holds 0 messages and the absent rider track is neutral under POL-NS-11, not favourable. The driver's SGD 3.60 compensation cannot be paid while chargeability of the fee is undecided.

Open question for the reviewer: did the driver hold position inside the 50 m STANDARD pickup radius continuously for at least 180 seconds across 17:07:36–17:10:51? The monetary effect (SGD 4.50) is below the SGD 8.00 automatic-execution threshold, but the amount stays frozen pending review.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this dispute is over the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on TRP-02732, which the driver terminated at 17:13:20 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW after pressing 'arrived' at 17:06:36. The fee can stand only if all four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold. Limb (a) (an 'arrived' event) and limb (d) (a no-show termination with no boarding event) are established by the trip record EV-TRIP-02732 (weight 1.0). The case turns on limb (c): a continuous in-geofence dwell of at least the 180-second free waiting period in force for this STANDARD-zone trip (platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180; no_show_threshold_sec is null).

The only evidence of that dwell is the GPS trace EV-GPS-02732, and it is impaired: weight_multiplier 0.39, issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE. It contains a 195.0-second sampling gap from 17:07:36 to 17:10:51 and coverage of only 80.5%, against the 120-second gap threshold in POL-NS-08(b) - a policy-level impairment, not merely a pre-pass flag. The trace shows two observed in-geofence stretches - 17:06:36 to 17:07:36 (60 s) and 17:10:51 to 17:13:16 (145 s, the fragment ending 4 s before cancellation) - and is silent across the 195-second gap between them. The trace's own derived figures disagree because of that gap: the arrival analysis reports a longest continuous run of 145 s (a 35 s shortfall against the 180 s minimum) and the qualifying-run analysis reports 400 s by treating the unobserved stretch as unbroken (accumulated in-geofence time is 205 s). Nothing in the record can settle which is right: the gap cannot show whether the driver left the radius and returned or held position throughout.

Because the sole evidence for the deciding fact is impaired under POL-NS-08(b), POL-NS-08 directs that the ruling may not exceed PARTIAL_REFUND and that the case escalates under POL-NS-09; and because that single carrier sits at 0.39, POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence at 0.39, below the 0.70 floor, which engages POL-NS-09(a). The case is therefore escalated: no money is moved, and the disputed SGD 4.50 is held rather than collected or refunded.

On the surviving claims. The rider's POL-NS-06 shortfall argument (longest continuous run 145 s versus the 180 s minimum) and the driver's contrary POL-NS-01/POL-NS-12-style argument (a 400 s qualifying run, so the dwell is met) are answered together: the impaired trace cannot establish either, so neither can carry a payment or a refund.
